title: file op dispatch
note: Dispatch repeated in ReadFileAndBytesCtx (1591), WriteFile (1742), EditFileWithCtx (1804), ReadFileRawCtx/WriteFileRaw/RemovePath/RenamePath (mutator.go:261-346). WriteFile vs WriteFileRaw differ only in tool name, perm, message (confirmed). But arms are NOT uniform: reads skip requireLiveSandboxRootForRelative, edit adds checkWritable before read, ReadFileRawCtx uses resolveWrite for a read, RenamePath has two endpoints with cross-scratch refusal. A single fileTarget needs an op-kind param; -250 LOC is optimistic (~-120).
revised_fix_plan: Land table test of denial parity first. Then (a) WriteFile -> thin wrapper over a shared write helper (WriteFileRaw with tool name param), (b) extract fileTarget(tool, path, mode read|write) for the 5 single-path ops; leave RenamePath's two-endpoint logic explicit. Do not change read-path requireLive behavior in the refactor.

note: 12 optional interfaces confirmed (execenv.go). ReadFileAndBytes has only test callers; EditFileWith only EditFile (local.go:1786) and confirmed_files_test. BUT 'only Local plus env_deny implements them' is wrong: agenttest.FakeEnv, DenyEnv and 18+ test ExecCommand implementers exist, and many test doubles deliberately implement StreamCommand/DetachCommand alone (job_shell_test.go, subagent_owned_job_drain_test.go, cmd/evener/run_drain_test.go) to exercise capability-absent branches. title: launch probes
note: Probe machinery is local.go:1329-1545 (~240 lines) as claimed, but the fix plan is wrong: login-shell stdout carries rc-file noise BEFORE the answer, and the answer is the LAST line (lastNonEmptyLine doc, 1452-1459). io.LimitReader keeps the head and would lose the answer on a noisy shell; the tail window in probeTrustedAnswer (1529) is load-bearing for the #4557 OOM bound. Platform() switch is unrelated trivia.
revised_fix_plan: If simplifying, keep only a tail ring buffer (cappedOutputBuffer already retains one) and drop the head+marker view; do not use LimitReader.
